turn.content:
The only issue is the tax amount. The contract clause KTR-V-036#3.1 sets VAT at 11% of the subtotal.

- Subtotal 1,915,600 × 11% = 210,716.00, but the invoice charges 229,872.
- 229,872 / 1,915,600 = 0.12 = 12%.

So the invoice applied a 12% rate instead of the contractual 11%.
